root_cause.text: In the `__audit_log_capset()` function within the audit subsystem, a copy-paste error caused the effective capability set to be erroneously assigned to the inheritable field instead of the actual inheritable capability set.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `kernel/auditsc.c` changes the assignment from `context->capset.cap.inheritable = new->cap_effective;` to `context->capset.cap.inheritable = new->cap_inheritable;`, directly correcting the misassignment described in the CVE report as a copy-paste error.

vuln_statements.explanation: Based on the vulnerability root cause, this statement contains a copy-paste error where the effective capability set (new->cap_effective) was incorrectly assigned to the inheritable field (entry->cap_inheritable) instead of using the actual inheritable capability set (new->cap_inheritable). This causes audit records to log incorrect capability information, potentially allowing privilege escalation or security bypass scenarios where inheritable capabilities are misreported.
